	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_WWPMAILTEMPLATEDESCRIPTION'

	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_WWPMAILTEMPLATESUBJECT'

	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_WWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERADDRESS'
		Do 'LoadWWPMailTemplateSenderAddressOptions'

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATENAME"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateName.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATENAME_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATEDESCRIPTION"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATEDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESUBJECT_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERADDRESS"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERADDRESS_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERNAME"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERNAME_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

					, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel)
